name: Magaki Souzou
source:
Souzou is the younger brother of the brainwasher [url=https://vndb.org/c57320]Magaki Souichi[/url].

He looks exactly like his two older brothers.

Unlike his brother, who made a living using brainwashing techniques, he drifted around aimlessly without a steady job.

Nevertheless, he still adores his older brother Souichi, and sometimes helps him out to pass the time.

[Edited from the [url=http://studiocharen.r.ribbon.to/houkago3/character.html]official site[/url]]
